errors.text_span: Eine schwarze durchgezogene Linie stellt die Importe dar
errors.evidence: The description mentions a black line for 'Importe', but the figure uses a blue line.
The description misses the overall purpose as described in the caption: 'Ex- und Importe von Waren sowie Handelsbilanzsaldo der USA'.
The y-axis description misses the detail that it has two opposite scales: one for Saldo (right) and one for Exporte/Importe (left).
The description does not mention that the Saldo is visually represented as bars in addition to a line format.
